stability.note: Error grows 1.3-1.5x per pulse: each pulse must be corrected before the next (0.6 ms at 1.6 kHz) by hardware loops (pellet mass, injection timing, wave phase); the AI tunes their gains and predicts drift. The pellet fuel caps an overshoot at 1.25x; a missed correction quenches the chain within a few pulses (restart by the startup driver).

phase.note: Wave phase must be set per pulse within the pulse period; the AI updates set-points over about a hundred pulses (tens of ms) from predicted versus measured yield, plume and leakage.

failures.consequence: burn quenches; thrust steps to zero on one engine
failures.response: other engines throttle to balance within ms; startup driver relights (1.74 GJ store = dozens of restarts)

failures.consequence: pulse up to 1.25x (fuel-capped); field overpressure, leakage spike
failures.response: next pellet lighter or delayed; ring current headroom sized for 1.25x

failures.mode: Phase drift of the transfer wave
failures.consequence: transfer share falls -> electrons heat -> photon share rises toward 47 %
failures.response: AI re-phases from the plume and photon diagnostics; below the threshold the chain quenches safely

failures.consequence: off-centre burn: asymmetric plume, more forward loss and leakage
failures.response: in-flight correction at the burn station (electromagnetic steering), metrology tracks each pellet

failures.consequence: nozzle field decays: plume loses collimation, leakage rises
failures.response: stop the chain within one pulse; ring energy dumped into its armour heat sink; dynamos recharge

failures.consequence: burn station off its line; thrust misaligned
failures.response: stop the chain; reel in; the other three engines carry a reduced, balanced burn

failures.consequence: torque on the ship from differential thrust
failures.response: pulse-rate trim per engine (0.3 % differential today) and canted tethers
